items.heading: Kranjska Klobasa with Sauerkraut
details: Key ingredients: sausage, sauerkraut, mustard
Simmer traditional Carniolan sausage gently until cooked through.
Warm sauerkraut on the side.
Slice the sausage and plate with the sauerkraut.
Serve with mustard and bread.

items.heading: Potica
details: Key ingredients: rolled dough, walnuts, honey, sugar
Roll a soft yeasted dough into a large thin sheet.
Spread a filling of ground walnuts, honey and sugar over the dough.
Roll the dough up tightly and coil it into a baking pan.
Bake until golden and let cool before slicing.
